title: Flying Domestic in NZ with Kids — Air NZ Tips, Baggage, and Seat Selection
meta_desc: Learn how to navigate Air NZ domestic flights with kids, including baggage allowance and seat selection tips
intro: As any parent knows, flying with kids can be a daunting task, especially when it comes to navigating the complex world of domestic air travel in New Zealand. With Air NZ's strict baggage policies and limited seat options, it's essential to plan ahead to ensure a smooth journey. In this article, we'll share our top tips for flying domestic with kids in NZ, including how to choose the best routes and seats, and how to make the most of your baggage allowance.

sections.heading: Choosing the Best Routes
sections.body: When it comes to domestic flights in NZ, some routes are more kid-friendly than others. For example, the short flight from Wellington to Christchurch is a great option for families, with a flight time of just over an hour and plenty of kid-friendly activities to enjoy in both cities. On the other hand, the longer flight from Auckland to Queenstown may be more challenging for young children, but the stunning scenery and outdoor activities in Queenstown make it well worth the trip.

sections.heading: Air NZ Baggage Allowance
list: One piece of checked luggage up to 23kg: $25-$35 NZD
One piece of carry-on luggage up to 7kg: free
Additional checked luggage: $25-$35 NZD per piece

sections.heading: Seat Selection Tips
sections.body: When flying with kids, it's essential to choose seats that are close together and offer plenty of legroom. Air NZ's Skycouch option is a great choice for families, as it allows you to convert three economy seats into a flat bed. However, this option can be pricey, with costs starting from $200 NZD per person.

sections.heading: Additional Tips and Tricks
list: Book your flights in advance to secure the best prices
Consider booking a morning flight to avoid delays and cancellations
Pack plenty of snacks and entertainment for your kids to enjoy during the flight
